# About GMEOW

A reasoning-centric, OWL 2 DL, upper-ontology-grounded super-vocabulary that unifies document metadata, entity descriptions, legal agreements, contacts and person-centric data. GMEOW is grounded in [gUFO](external/ontologies.md#target-gufo) and aligned to FOAF, REL, DOAP, [PROV-O](external/ontologies.md#target-prov), schema.org and Wikidata.

- **Version:** `0.1.0`
- **Namespace:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/>
